_comment: SANITIZED EXPORT — 'Tracking' workflow. Receives a scheduled pass on the /schedule-pass webhook, checks a shared token, waits until 5 min before AOS, then routes by location. BARCELONA branch: SSH into the homelab, record baseband with rtl_sdr (2.4 MS/s), decode with the alpha SatDump, write meta.json, then re-decode/project with SatDump 1.2.2. THEDING branch: SSH into the remote netbook (host alias 'theding', tunnel underneath), record at 250 kS/s, rsync the raw file back to the homelab, decode there. BEFORE USE: set PASS_SECRET env var; adjust host paths (/home/USER/...); set up your own SSH host aliases + SatDump build paths; the SSH nodes use n8n SSH credentials you must recreate. Internal host IPs and the exact remote alias have been genericized.
name: Tracking

parameters.command:
=pkill dump1090 || true; pkill AIS-catcher || true; pkill rtl_sdr || true; sleep 1
rtl_biast -b 1
cd /home/USER/SatDump/build
rtl_sdr -f {{ $json.query.satFrequency }} -s 2400000 -g 20 /home/USER/satellite-images/meteor_$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M).raw &
RTL_PID=$!
nohup bash -c "sleep {{ Number($json.query.endUTC) - Number($json.query.startUTC) + 20 * 60 }} && kill $RTL_PID 2>/dev/null" &>/dev/null &
sleep {{ Number($json.query.endUTC) - Number($json.query.startUTC) + 10 * 60 }}
kill $RTL_PID 2>/dev/null
sleep 2

RAW=$(ls -t /home/USER/satellite-images/*.raw 2>/dev/null | head -1)
if [ -z "$RAW" ]; then echo "No raw file found, skipping decode"; exit 0; fi

DECODED_DIR="/home/USER/satellite-images/decoded_$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M)"
mkdir -p "$DECODED_DIR"

timeout 600 /home/USER/SatDump/build/satdump pipeline meteor_m2-x_lrpt baseband "$RAW" "$DECODED_DIR" \
  --samplerate=2400000 \
  --baseband_format=cu8 \
  --fill_missing

FILLED_DIR="$DECODED_DIR/MSU-MR (Filled)"
if [ -d "$FILLED_DIR" ]; then
    cp "$FILLED_DIR/"*.png "$DECODED_DIR/MSU-MR/" 2>/dev/null || true
fi

START_AZ={{ $json.query.startAz }}
if (( $(echo "$START_AZ > 90 && $START_AZ < 270" | bc -l) )); then
  DIRECTION="NtoS"
else
  DIRECTION="StoN"
fi

jq -n \
    --arg satellite "{{ $json.query.satName }}" \
    --argjson maxEl "{{ $json.query.maxEl }}" \
    --argjson frequency "{{ $json.query.satFrequency }}" \
    --argjson gain 20 \
    --argjson samplerate 2400000 \
    --arg location "barcelona" \
    --arg date "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d')" \
    --arg time "$(date '+%H:%M') CEST" \
    --arg direction "$DIRECTION" \
    '{satellite: $satellite, maxEl: $maxEl, frequency: $frequency, gain: $gain, samplerate: $samplerate, location: $location, date: $date, time: $time, direction: $direction}' > "$DECODED_DIR/meta.json"

bash /home/USER/satellite-images/rebuild-passes.sh
echo "RAW_PATH=$RAW"
echo "DECODED_DIR_PATH=$DECODED_DIR"

=DURATION=$(( {{ Number($json.query.endUTC) - Number($json.query.startUTC) }} + 60 ))
FREQ={{ $json.query.satFrequency }}
START_AZ={{ $json.query.startAz }}
SATNAME="{{ $json.query.satName }}"
MAXEL={{ $json.query.maxEl }}

ssh theding "DURATION='$DURATION' FREQ='$FREQ' START_AZ='$START_AZ' SATNAME='$SATNAME' MAXEL='$MAXEL' bash -s" <<'ENDOFSCRIPT'

FREQ="${FREQ//$'\r'/}"; FREQ="${FREQ:-0}"
MAXEL="${MAXEL//$'\r'/}"; MAXEL="${MAXEL:-0}"
START_AZ="${START_AZ//$'\r'/}"
DURATION="${DURATION//$'\r'/}"
SATNAME="${SATNAME//$'\r'/}"

pkill rtl_sdr || true; sleep 1
rtl_biast -b 1 2>/dev/null || true

TS=$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M)
RAW="/home/USER/satellite-images/meteor_${TS}.raw"
mkdir -p /home/USER/satellite-images

rtl_sdr -f "$FREQ" -s 250000 -g 20 "$RAW" &
RTL_PID=$!
nohup bash -c "sleep $((DURATION + 120)) && kill $RTL_PID 2>/dev/null" &>/dev/null &
sleep "$DURATION"
kill $RTL_PID 2>/dev/null
sleep 2

rtl_biast -b 0 2>/dev/null || true

if [ ! -s "$RAW" ]; then echo "No raw file captured"; exit 0; fi

if (( $(echo "$START_AZ > 90 && $START_AZ < 270" | bc -l) )); then
  DIRECTION="NtoS"
else
  DIRECTION="StoN"
fi

jq -n \
    --arg satellite "$SATNAME" \
    --argjson maxEl "$MAXEL" \
    --argjson frequency "$FREQ" \
    --argjson gain 20 \
    --argjson samplerate 250000 \
    --arg location "theding" \
    --arg date "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d')" \
    --arg time "$(date '+%H:%M') CEST" \
    --arg direction "$DIRECTION" \
    '{satellite: $satellite, maxEl: $maxEl, frequency: $frequency, gain: $gain, samplerate: $samplerate, location: $location, date: $date, time: $time, direction: $direction}' > "${RAW}.meta.json"

echo "RAW_PATH=$RAW"
echo "META_PATH=${RAW}.meta.json"
ENDOFSCRIPT

=STDOUT_BLOB='{{ $('Théding reception').item.json.stdout }}'
REMOTE_RAW=$(echo "$STDOUT_BLOB" | grep "RAW_PATH=" | cut -d'=' -f2-)
REMOTE_META=$(echo "$STDOUT_BLOB" | grep "META_PATH=" | cut -d'=' -f2-)

if [ -z "$REMOTE_RAW" ]; then echo "No remote raw path, skipping"; exit 0; fi

LOCAL_RAW="/home/USER/satellite-images/$(basename "$REMOTE_RAW")"
rsync -e ssh theding:"$REMOTE_RAW"  "$LOCAL_RAW"
rsync -e ssh theding:"$REMOTE_META" "${LOCAL_RAW}.meta.json"

if [ ! -s "$LOCAL_RAW" ]; then echo "Transfer failed"; exit 1; fi

DECODED_DIR="/home/USER/satellite-images/decoded_$(basename "$REMOTE_RAW" .raw | sed 's/meteor_//')"
mkdir -p "$DECODED_DIR"

cd /home/USER/SatDump/build
timeout 600 ./satdump pipeline meteor_m2-x_lrpt baseband "$LOCAL_RAW" "$DECODED_DIR" \
  --samplerate=250000 \
  --baseband_format=cu8 \
  --fill_missing

FILLED_DIR="$DECODED_DIR/MSU-MR (Filled)"
if [ -d "$FILLED_DIR" ]; then
    cp "$FILLED_DIR/"*.png "$DECODED_DIR/MSU-MR/" 2>/dev/null || true
fi

cp "${LOCAL_RAW}.meta.json" "$DECODED_DIR/meta.json"

bash /home/USER/satellite-images/rebuild-passes.sh
echo "RAW_PATH=$LOCAL_RAW"
echo "DECODED_DIR_PATH=$DECODED_DIR"

=STDOUT_BLOB='{{ $('Consolidate image processing outputs').item.json.stdout }}'
RAW=$(echo "$STDOUT_BLOB" | grep "RAW_PATH=" | cut -d'=' -f2-)
DECODED_DIR=$(echo "$STDOUT_BLOB" | grep "DECODED_DIR_PATH=" | cut -d'=' -f2-)

if [ -z "$RAW" ] || [ -z "$DECODED_DIR" ]; then
  echo "Could not parse RAW/DECODED_DIR from previous node, skipping"
  exit 0
fi

cd /home/USER/SatDump-1.2.2/build
SR=$(jq -r '.samplerate // 2400000' "$DECODED_DIR/meta.json")
timeout 600 ./satdump meteor_m2-x_lrpt baseband "$RAW" "$DECODED_DIR" \
  --samplerate "$SR" --baseband_format cu8 --fill_missing

# Flip NtoS channel images 180 degrees if needed
DIRECTION=$(jq -r '.direction // ""' "$DECODED_DIR/meta.json")
if [ "$DIRECTION" = "NtoS" ]; then
  for f in "$DECODED_DIR/MSU-MR/MSU-MR-"{1,2,3}.png; do
    [ -f "$f" ] && convert "$f" -rotate 180 "$f"
  done
fi

bash /home/USER/satellite-images/rebuild-passes.sh
